query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id',e.id,'contentSha256',btrim(e.content_sha256::text), 'locator',e.source_locator,'updatedAt',e.updated_at, 'promptInjectionFlags',COALESCE(d.prompt_injection_flags,'[]'::jsonb) ) ORDER BY e.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.evidence e LEFT JOIN raw.source_documents d ON d.id=e.source_document_id WHERE e.case_id=$1 AND e.id=ANY($2::uuid[]) AND e.verification_status='VERIFIED'
